## free-tier-llm-landscape
- **What matters:** Free tiers at Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Google Gemini and Hugging Face frequently change rate limits, model availability, routing and terms; I cannot confirm any specific recent change.
- **Why it matters:** An agent that runs only on free tiers can break silently when a model is renamed, capped or removed, or when a terms change forbids automated use.
- **Verify:** Check each provider's current docs and terms directly, plus OpenRouter's status/model list, before any deployment.

## agent-safety-practice
- **What matters:** Use tiered human approval for destructive or outward-facing actions, run code in sandboxes/containers with no network or credentials by default, treat all tool output as untrusted to resist prompt injection, and keep immutable audit logs.
- **Why it matters:** Autonomous coding agents can exfiltrate secrets, mutate repos or follow injected instructions from issues, pages and dependencies; approvals plus blast-radius limits reduce damage.
- **Verify:** Confirm
